verdict.rationale: Mastra docs confirm agents can be deployed as a server to any Node.js-compatible environment (or self-hosted, or via Cloudflare/Deno/Bun runtimes), and Studio provides a way to test/run agents, implying an API-callable server exists. However, there's no explicit documentation of a managed/hosted deployment platform run by Mastra itself with concrete API endpoint specs, auth, or scaling details, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of calling a deployed agent as an API endpoint. missing for 10: first-party managed hosting platform details (beyond self-host/BYO-cloud), concrete API endpoint schema/example, independent verification of production deployment-as-API.
